sources.text: O Xbox Game Pass é um dos serviços de assinatura de games mais democráticos da atualidade, já que é possível acessá-lo de diferentes plataformas — incluindo os próprios, consoles da Microsoft, assim como no PC, nuvem, celulares, tablets e até Smart TVs Samsung e LG com modelos de 2022 para cá. Felizmente, seu catálogo também é atualizado quase que semanalmente, trazendo inúmeras opções para os assinantes aproveitarem — e o melhor de tudo: gastando pouco em comparação às novas tendências de preços da indústria. Se veio em busca de novos jogos para jogar através do Xbox Game Pass , está no lugar certo. O serviço ganhou um reforço de peso esta semana com a chegada de cinco títulos para os assinantes aproveitarem. Confira abaixo mais informações sobre as novas aventuras! Disponível no lançamento no Xbox Game Pass, Warhammer Survivors é um jogo de ação no estilo bullet heaven, inspirado em Vampire Survivors . Com visual em pixel art, o game coloca os jogadores contra grandes hordas de inimigos, utilizando armas, habilidades e personagens inspirados no universo de Warhammer . Também disponível no lançamento no Xbox Game Pass, Tanuki: Pon’s Summer coloca os jogadores no controle de Pon, um guaxinim que precisa restaurar um santuário antes do Festival Tanuki. Para cumprir a missão, será necessário entregar encomendas de bicicleta, fazer amizades e ajudar os moradores em atividades como preparar sushi e participar de lutas de sumô. Outro game a compor o Game Pass no lançamento, Hope in the City é uma aventura de mistério protagonizada por Hope Song, uma jovem de 17 anos que descobre o desaparecimento dos pais ao voltar para casa. Durante a investigação, os jogadores precisam transformar desenhos em pistas e desvendar segredos cada vez mais misteriosos sobre a família da protagonista. Thronefall é um jogo de estratégia minimalista em que os jogadores precisam construir e administrar um reino durante o dia e protegê-lo de invasores durante a noite. Para sobreviver às ondas de inimigos, será necessário equilibrar a economia, fortalecer as defesas, recrutar soldados e participar diretamente dos combates. Por fim, em John Carpenter’s Toxic Commando , até quatro jogadores podem se unir em uma aventura cooperativa de ação e sobrevivência contra hordas de zumbis. Ambientado em um mundo tomado por criaturas, o game apresenta missões em cenários semiabertos e coloca os jogadores em uma jornada para tentar salvar a humanidade. stories.title: PS5 QSSR Updates Revealed for Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Arc Raiders, and More
stories.summary: Sony has confirmed Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Arc Raiders, and four more games are receiving QSSR support on base PS5s.

sources.name: IGN
sources.title: PS5 QSSR Updates Revealed for Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Arc Raiders, and More
sources.text: Sony has confirmed Marvel's Spider-Man 2 , Arc Raiders , and four more games are receiving QSSR support on base PS5s. The list of six newcomers joining the small-but-growing group of supported games was unveiled in a PlayStation.Blog post . In addition to confirmation that incoming updates will add QSSR (Quick Spectral Super Resolution), the post included testimonials from each of the studios' developers, who shared how the tech will impact visuals. When Sony pulled back the curtain on QSSR in October, it came with confirmation that it had already been implemented in Marvel's Wolverine and Ghost of Yōtei. Now, we know that Insomniac's Marvel's Spider-Man 2, Remedy Entertainment's Control Resonant , Embark Studios' Arc Raiders and The Finals , Hello Games' No Man's Sky , and Expression Games' Hell Let Loose: Vietnam will soon take advantage of the AI upscaling tech. In the case of Marvel's Spider-Man 2, QSSR is available as part of a new update that's out now. "Having seen great results integrating QSSR in Marvel’s Wolverine, our team decided to bring it to Marvel’s Spider-Man 2 as well, in an update that’s live now!" Insomniac head of technology Mike Fitzgerald said. "We’re excited for players to swing back into our 2023 title and see QSSR’s exciting image stability and sharpness benefits in both Fidelity and Performance modes." Remedy said QSSR will bring noticeable improvements in image stability and fine detail when it launches in a new update in December. Hello Games founder Sean Murray, meanwhile, promised that players can look forward to No Man's Sky looking "sharper, cleaner, and more beautiful" at the "best possible framerate" in the next few weeks. When exactly The Finals, Arc Raiders, and Hell Let Loose: Vietnam will receive their updates has yet to be announced. "With the new QSSR coming soon to ARC Raiders and The Finals, we can deliver increased sharpness, better environmental clarity, and overall visual improvements to even more PlayStation players," Embark said. "We are very happy to see Sony’s continued investment in PlayStation technology translate into meaningful improvements for all players, bringing more immersive experiences across the PlayStation ecosystem." Sony then teased that developers interested in using QSSR are "just getting started." More PS5 games are set to receive similar updates in the coming months, though which titles will join the list remains to be seen. Michael Cripe is a freelance writer with IGN. He's best known for his work at sites like The Pitch, The Escapist, and OnlySP. Be sure to give him a follow on Bluesky (@mikecripe.bsky.social) and Twitter (@MikeCripe).

sources.name: The Verge Games
sources.title: Here are the 25 original Xbox games you can now play on PC
sources.text: Microsoft’s adding achievements to original Xbox games for the first time, too. Microsoft’s adding achievements to original Xbox games for the first time, too. For the 25th anniversary of Xbox , Microsoft is beginning to make good on its paid “next-gen game preservation” promise. Starting today, you can play 25 different original Xbox games on your Windows PC, as long as you have (or are willing to pay) for digital copies. In July, Microsoft originally launched the idea with just four Xbox games , so 25 is progress, and Microsoft says all these games are now playable with keyboard and mouse. Plus, Microsoft says it’s adding achievements to original Xbox games for the first time, starting with four games: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic and its sequel, Blinx: The Time Sweeper , and Conker: Live and Reloaded . You can unlock achievements playing them on Xbox One and Xbox Series consoles as well, after a system update. More games should get them in future. Here’s the full list of Xbox on PC games, with the 21 new additions in bold: Yes, that’s a lot of Star Wars games, most of which already have a PC version, and few games that were exclusive to Xbox at the time. (But many of those Star Wars games were excellent.) You also won’t be able to use an original Xbox disc to play these games, I’m afraid, as original Xbox (and Xbox 360) discs aren’t part of Microsoft’s disc-to-digital program; they predate the unique serial number that Microsoft embedded into Xbox One discs. In case you’re wondering, Xbox on PC backward compatibility appears to be powered by an emulator . Also, most of the new games aren’t currently included with Xbox Game Pass, according to Microsoft; just Blinx, Conker, Crimson Skies, Fusion Frenzy, Morrowind, and Grabbed by the Ghoulies . Leaked Microsoft documents previously showed us that October 2026 would be the “full launch” of original Xbox games on PC, while Xbox 360 games would have a “gradual” rollout to next-gen consoles between 2027 and 2028, which are when Microsoft is expected to roll out a handheld and a Helix box respectively . The way things are shaping up, the Xbox Helix should play games from every generation of Xbox , even if Helix fundamentally turns out to be a Windows PC.

sources.title: 21 original Xbox games are now on PC via backward compatibility
sources.text: There are now 25 classic Xbox games available on PC, and four have achievements Xbox has added 21 new original Xbox games to its backwards compatibility catalogue on PC. The Elder Scrolls 3: Morrowind, Star Wars Battlefront, Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic, TimeSplitters 2, and more have been added to the catalogue, bringing the roster up to 25 on PC . Four of the games available on the service will also have unlockable achievements. The following games will join the PC backward compatibility catalogue with achievements:Â Star Wars: KOTOR, Star Wars: KOTOR 2, Blinx: The Time Sweeper, and Conker: Live and Reloaded. You can unlock achievements for these games when playing on an Xbox console too. This announcement comes as part of Xbox’s ongoing FanFest. Xbox CEO Asha Sharma also used the event to reveal that id Software is working on its next game after Doom: The Dark Ages . Xbox will also be hoping that this earns it some goodwill in the gaming community, following a year full of layoffs . These layoffs are part of Xbox’s ongoing “reset”, which has seen multiple studios spun off, sold, or merged with others, such as Bethesda and Obsidian , who now work together. Others have seen a massively reduced headcount.

sources.name: Eurogamer
sources.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting its own four-player version of the series' staple Firefight mode, for free, "this winter"
sources.text: Last night, Xbox Game Studios and Halo Studios have announced a free update for the recently-released Halo: Campaign Evolved, which promises to add the four-player co-operative PvE mode, Firefight, to the game. "For nearly two decades, Firefight has been a Halo favorite, challenging Spartans to team up, hold the line, and survive wave after wave of enemies," says Halo Studios director of competitive engagement Tahir Hasangjekaj said in a dedicated post on the Xbox website. "The tradition continues this winter as we add the four-player cooperative PvE mode to Halo: Campaign Evolved in a free update." Though we don't have a release date for the update yet, Hasangjekaj does explicitly state "this Winter" as a window, and promises that we'll hear more information about the update at Halo Fest - due to run from 12th to 13hth December in Seattle, Washington. My money would be on a release around then, therefore. "We're kicking things off tonight at Xbox FanFest, where attendees will be the first to jump in and experience Firefight across new maps and armed with plenty of weapons to help even the odds." It seems there's already a playable build of the mode, then. It's worth noting that this is quite an odd news blast from Xbox, since the last official information we heard about the Halo brand was that the next major Halo game being developed by Activision , as Halo Studios all but closes as part of Microsoft's Xbox ' restructuring ' that saw one key member behind Halo: Campaign Evolved promoted and laid off within the same week . As things stand, we don't know anything specific about the future of the series, but there are plenty of rumours that the next title will be a reboot developed by Call of Duty's Sledgehammer Games. It's been fairly busy 24 hours for Xbox: as well as this Halo update, we've heard from Asha Sharma as she celebrated the 25th anniversary of Xbox by seemingly going all-in on Gen AI . Elsewhere, we got the announcement that Wolfenstein 3 is in development over at MachineGames , headed up by Hugo Martin.

sources.name: PC Gamer
sources.title: Halo: Campaign Evolved is getting Firefight as a free update, though I'm not sure it'll do much to change the remake's fortunes
sources.text: More info to be announced at Halo Fest in December. Xbox has announced the first update for Halo: Campaign Evolved since August, one which will add Firefight to the remake's overhaul of the original game's story. Firefight is Halo's cooperative PvE mode which debuted in Halo 3: ODST . It's a round-based defence affair where players must survive as long as possible against increasingly dangerous waves of enemies. Following ODST, the mode appeared in every subsequent Halo game with the exception of Halo 4, which featured a mode called Spartan Ops instead. In its announcement , Xbox was extremely light on details regarding the addition of Firefight. But the company said it'll share "additional details" about the Firefight update during Halo Fest, which takes place over the weekend commencing December 12. I'm pleased to see Campaign Evolved getting some more features, but the announcement also increases my sense that Xbox really doesn't know what to do with Halo at present. Campaign Evolved itself felt like a collective shrug from Halo Studios, a glossy but unambitious overhaul of the original game, with three new levels that nobody liked and shorn of the multiplayer that the PC version so enjoyable in the early 2000s. Morgan Park felt similarly in his Halo: Campaign Evolved Review . "It was cool to see another interpretation of a game special to me, but the glitzy coat of paint primarily highlights how right Bungie got it in 2001, and how its modern stewards are nudging Halo in an unremarkable direction," he wrote back in July. A Firefight mode, coming nearly six months after launch with almost complete radio silence since August, smacks more of "We need something for Halo Fest" than the start of a bright new future for the remake. Not that I expected it to magically rejuvenate Halo. But that lack of expectation, of anticipation, is in itself part of the problem. I could be wrong, of course. As part of Xbox's "reset"—which has included laying off thousands of staff and saying sayonara to several studios—Xbox also handed control of Halo over to Activision . So perhaps bringing back Firefight is the first step in Activision 's plan—whatever that is. Some have suggested that Xbox wants Halo to be a more Call of Duty -like experience, which would certainly make sense from Xbox's perspective. Whether Halo can actually be that is, of course, another matter entirely. stories.title: Take-Two boss isn't ruling out a GTA movie or TV show, but says they're "very, very selective" about who they work with
stories.summary: A Grand Theft Auto movie could still happen one day

sources.name: GamesRadar
sources.title: Take-Two boss isn't ruling out a GTA movie or TV show, but says they're "very, very selective" about who they work with
sources.text: A Grand Theft Auto movie could still happen one day With less than a week to go until the release of GTA 6 – aka the biggest entertainment release of all time – the boss of GTA publisher Take-Two isn't ruling out a GTA movie or TV show, but suggests one hasn't happened yet because they're "very, very selective" about who they work with. Speaking on The David Rubenstein Show , Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick was asked why, after 30 years and six mainline games, there still hasn't been a GTA adaptation, saying in response: "We're very careful about line extensions [adaptations in other mediums] because this is a creative company and our goal is to make the best entertainment on Earth. "We would make a movie or a television show based on our IP if our creative teams were passionate about it," Zelnick continued. "If they thought that would somehow engage and delight our consumers. It's a high bar to do that, and of course there's always the risk of failure. So we don't rule it out, but we're very, very selective." Video game adaptations are currently all the rage in Hollywood. 2026 alone saw the release of Resident Evil , Mortal Kombat 2, Street Fighter, Iron Lung, Exit 8, Return to Silent Hill, and the back half of Fallout season 2 , and 2027 looks to be even bigger for video games on screen with The Legend of Zelda movie , A Minecraft Movie 2 , Sonic 4 , and potentially a wave of TV shows set to release. GTA is a unique case, however, and given its scale, it's arguable that Rockstar and Take-Two would have more to lose than gain from a GTA movie or TV show if any adaptation can't live up to the medium-defining legacy of the games. That said, imagine a GTA movie directed by one of the crime movie greats – a Michael Mann or a Martin Scorsese. Could Rockstar resist if one of the legendary filmmakers who informed much of their work wanted to return the favor? For now, the closest we have to a GTA movie is the 2015 docudrama The Gamechangers, which stars Harry Potter's Daniel Radcliffe as then Rockstar Games President Sam Houser and depicts the legal battle with Florida attorney Jack Thompson over the supposed psychological effects of violent games. Rockstar, famously, weren't fans, tweeting : "Was Basil Brush busy? What exactly is this random, made-up bollocks?" As for GTA 6, the map for the long-awaited Vice City-set game just leaked , and it could be teasing a UFO Easter egg. For that and much more, head on over to our countdown to GTA 6 landing page. GTA 6 releases on November 19. For more, check out our list of the best video game movies , and our guide to all the upcoming video game movies and shows heading our way. sources.text: O Checkpoint desta sexta-feira (13) chega com comentários de Strauss Zelnick, CEO da Take-Two, sobre uma possível adaptação da franquia GTA para os cinemas ou uma série de TV. Segundo o executivo, se houver “paixão” do time responsável, isso pode acabar acontecendo eventualmente. Em outras notícias, a id Software, estúdio de DOOM que sofreu uma onda de demissões recentemente, confirmou que está trabalhando em um novo projeto. A notícia foi revelada pela própria CEO do Xbox, Asha Sharma. Quer saber o que mais rolou no mundo dos games nesta sexta (13)? Então prepara o cafezinho da tarde e acompanhe o VOXL por mais um Checkpoint ! Strauss Zelnick, CEO da Take-Two Interactive, comentou sobre a possibilidade de GTA ganhar um filme ou série de TV. Em entrevista a David Rubinstein, o executivo afirmou que a empresa não descarta adaptar suas franquias para outras mídias, mas adota uma postura cautelosa sobre esse tipo de projeto. “Produziríamos um filme ou uma série de televisão baseada em nossa propriedade intelectual se nossas equipes criativas fossem apaixonadas por isso”, explicou Zelnick. O executivo também destacou que a adaptação precisaria ter potencial para “cativar e encantar” o público, reforçando que a Take-Two é seletiva e não pretende avançar com projetos apenas por interesse comercial. A id Software, responsável pela franquia DOOM , confirmou que já está desenvolvendo seu próximo jogo, mesmo após ser afetada por uma onda de demissões na Xbox. A informação foi divulgada durante o Xbox FanFest e confirmada pela CEO da divisão, Asha Sharma. Em publicação nas redes sociais, o estúdio afirmou que o novo projeto está sendo desenvolvido por equipes no Texas e em Frankfurt, novamente sob a direção de Hugo Martin. “Ainda vai demorar um pouco até que possamos compartilhar mais detalhes, mas mal podemos esperar para que vocês vejam no que estamos trabalhando”, declarou a desenvolvedora. Jeff Kaplan, ex-diretor de Overwatch , revelou que teve constantes desentendimentos com a liderança da Blizzard nos anos anteriores à sua saída, em 2021. Em entrevista ao canal Gaming World Interviews, o desenvolvedor afirmou que perdeu o controle sobre os rumos do jogo a partir de 2018 e chegou a discordar publicamente de decisões da empresa. Entre os principais conflitos, Kaplan citou o anúncio de Overwatch 2 em 2019 e a possibilidade de vender novos heróis, medida à qual se opôs. “Eles também estavam tentando me fazer vender heróis. Essa era uma linha que eu não estava disposto a quebrar. Foi a exigência mais absurda”, declarou o ex-diretor. Trent Oster, cofundador da BioWare, afirmou que ainda existem muitas histórias que poderiam ser exploradas nas franquias do estúdio, como Dragon Age e Mass Effect . Após o anúncio do fechamento da desenvolvedora, o executivo compartilhou mensagens de apoio e demonstrou interesse em reunir antigos integrantes da equipe para trabalhar novamente nas séries. “Em 1994, alguns de nós iniciamos a jornada que se tornou a BioWare. Acho que ainda há muitas histórias para serem contadas”, escreveu Oster nas redes sociais. Ele também demonstrou interesse em reunir desenvolvedores originais para trabalhar em Mass Effect e convidou James Ohlen, criador de Dragon Age , que respondeu que voltar à franquia seria um sonho. Uma falha global que atingiu os serviços da Microsoft nesta sexta (13) também está afetando o ecossistema do Xbox. Usuários relatam problemas para fazer login nas contas, carregar jogos digitais e acessar conteúdos salvos na nuvem. O Xbox Cloud Gaming também apresenta instabilidades, com jogadores enfrentando longas filas de espera e desconexões durante o uso. A Microsoft informou que trabalha para mitigar os impactos e normalizar os serviços, mas as primeiras correções não resolveram completamente o problema. sources.title: Ahead of GTA 6, Take-Two CEO calls out Anthropic and OpenAI over AI game clones
sources.text: After Claude blocked users from "recreating someone else's specific game" In the lead up to GTA 6 's long-awaited launch, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has called out companies like Anthropic and OpenAI for allowing users to plagiarize and clone pre-existing games using generative AI. Generative AI's usage in game development has been highly controversial for many reasons, but in recent months, AI copycats have become an increasingly prevalent issue. Some Steam developers even cancelled demos or playtests out of fear their games would be cloned and put up for sale before their official release dates. Copycats of popular games like Mecca Chameleon can sometimes flood the storefront in no time, too. "I think all companies should be protecting intellectual property, their own and everyone else's," Zelnick says when asked if he'd like to see more AI companies restrict users from reverse engineering games, in an interview with IGN . "And if you're in the intellectual property business, which Anthropic is and OpenAI is, then it seems ironic on the one hand to stomp on someone else's IP and hope that yours is protected," he adds. Anthropic recently added a new rule to Claude's backend code to block users from "recreating someone else's specific game," after lots of developers essentially had their work ripped off in mere minutes. The restriction might also stop Claude from being used in the tidal wave of vibe-coded recompilations we've seen in recent months - Mario Kart Wii , Banjo-Tooie and The Legend of Zelda: Link's Awakening included. "Using Claude to infringe IP is against our usage policy," Anthropic's member of technical staff Addy Osmani said at the time. "Original games, genre games, and games built from your own designs and assets are meant to keep working." ChatGPT owner OpenAI seemingly has no such restrictions in place for now. Weekly digests, tales from the communities you love, and more Take-Two boss isn't ruling out a GTA movie or TV show, but says they're "very, very selective" about who they work with Kaan freelances for various websites including Rock Paper Shotgun, Eurogamer, and this one, Gamesradar. He particularly enjoys writing about spooky indies, throwback RPGs, and anything that's vaguely silly. Also has an English Literature and Film Studies degree that he'll soon forget. sources.name: Insider Gaming
sources.title: GTA 6 AI Cloning Is Not a Financial Threat, Says Take-Two CEO
sources.text: Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick frames AI game cloning as a creative concern, emphasizing Rockstar’s intended experience and IP protection. With less than a week until Grand Theft Auto 6 launches, Zelnick was recently asked about the growing number of video games being reverse-engineered by AI and unofficially released native PC ports. He made it clear that he doesn’t believe this poses a financial threat to the company, but he is concerned about the creative implications. “I don’t think it’s a financial matter, in terms of a threat to our business. I do think it’s a creative matter. It’s important to everyone, our developers and our consumers alike, to deliver the experience Rockstar envisions,” he told IGN . “We are focused on these concerns. We’re not in the least cavalier about them. Technology is advancing quickly. At the same time, I do think that pretty much everyone wants the Rockstar experience as Rockstar intended.” Furthermore, Strauss Zelnick was asked about Anthropic’s recent steps to prevent its AI agent, Claude, from reverse-engineering games. Zelnick wants all AI companies to take the necessary steps to protect intellectual property—not just their own, but everyone’s. “If you’re in the intellectual property business, which Anthropic is and OpenAI is, then it seems ironic on the one hand to stomp on someone else’s IP and hope that yours is protected,” he said. Grand Theft Auto 6 officially releases on November 19. It will be available on PlayStation 5 and XBOX Series consoles. If you have a last-gen XBOX, cloud play is an option for experiencing GTA 6. After years in wrestling journalism, I’ve transitioned to video games, another passion of mine.

sources.title: New Grand Theft Auto 6 trailer is for a TV show that exists within Grand Theft Auto 6
sources.text: Macca and Friends is coming to Weazel TV on November 19. Get ready for some wheels within wheels, as DiscussingFilm has revealed an animated trailer for a Grand Theft Auto 6 TV show—and I don't mean a trailer for a show about GTA 6, but a trailer for a show in GTA 6. Macca and Friends, as the show is known, follows the adventures of a gang of anthropomorphic Floridian—Leonidan, I suppose—animals as they try to find their way in the world, accompanied to some extent by a beefed-up cop. The animals are cops too. It's a bit like Scooby Doo, maybe, but more egalitarian. Rockstar hasn't said anything about the show, but this isn't the first appearance of Macca: A Macca and Friends mural appeared in a real-life BurgerShot that was set up in Miami's Kaseya Center in October, and a billboard for the show was erected in Miami as well. Both advertised Macca and Friends as "coming November 19 on Weazel," a Fox-like television channel that exists within the GTA universe. How much of an actual, full-on show Rockstar has constructed here, I cannot say. Remedy has done similar things with its games, but those are just brief snippets delivering a little bit of meta narrative ; Rockstar, by comparison, gave us multiple stand-up comedy shows in GTA 5 and black-and-white films in Red Dead Redemption 2… not to mention, fully animated horse testicles . In that light, is it hard to believe they may have created an entire animated series for GTA 6? It might just be another blast from the GTA marketing machine—Rockstar is also literally renting the Miami Heat to promote its game, after all. At this point I don't think anything's off the table. PlayStation and Xbox owners will find out in less than a week: Grand Theft Auto 6 launches on November 19. A PC release date (or any kind of PC announcement at all) remains elusive. Andy has been gaming on PCs from the very beginning, starting as a youngster with text adventures and primitive action games on a cassette-based TRS80. From there he graduated to the glory days of Sierra Online adventures and Microprose sims, ran a local BBS, learned how to build PCs, and developed a longstanding love of RPGs, immersive sims, and shooters. He began writing videogame news in 2007 for The Escapist and somehow managed to avoid getting fired until 2014, when he joined the storied ranks of PC Gamer. He covers all aspects of the industry, from new game announcements and patch notes to legal disputes, Twitch beefs, esports, and Henry Cavill. Lots of Henry Cavill. sources.name: PlayStation Blog
sources.title: The Outer Worlds 2’s first DLC arrives December 2
sources.text: The first in a two-part Side Effects Guaranteed narrative adventure arrives soon, with part two coming spring 2027. The time has come to expand on the experience for The Outer Worlds 2 with the first of a two-part story expansion, Side Effects Guaranteed, arriving on December 2. After a distress signal from a derelict ship is picked up, you and your crew quickly get embroiled into the story of an abandoned settlement, a power struggle for the future of the Sub Rosa criminal organization, and the fate of a team who has been subjected to something that will cause them all to die from explosive cell death. Really, it’s more a liquefaction than explosion, but it means death nonetheless. A brand new story filled with moral quandaries and consequences big and small isn’t the only thing you’ll experience in the first DLC. An Earth Directorate Commander should always be sure to have a weapon at their side, and there are five new weapons to add to the arsenal. Such as the Immobilizer. Think of it like a gun that makes gravity forget to exist around its target, allowing them to float in the air, so you can switch to another weapon and pick them off as you like. Great for combining with grenades for anti-gravity explosions or the Tactical Time Dilation device for slowing down time and getting some critical shots in. There is also the 1/6 Resolver that allows every sixth bullet that is fired from it to pack an extra special punch. For those who built their characters just right, they won’t have to empty the gun every time to get that critical hit, either. Other weapons include a weapon that does additional damage to creatures, a special Tossball Stick, and a new plasma weapon for some energy fun. Yet it isn’t all about the weapons. Side Effects Guaranteed will also bring with it a level cap increase up to 36, new perks, new flaws, and a new Sub Rosa radio station with 20 new songs. There is also the all-new region of Elysium Valley to explore with unique quests and new facilities to make your way through. That’s a lot of new! While the events of the DLC do trigger right before the point of no return in the main game, there is also a way to jump easily into the action. From the main menu if you start a new game, you will see an option to start Side Effects Guaranteed directly. This will load a pre-made character at level 27 that you can assign skill points and perks to so you can experience the DLC however you’d like and get started right away. Not happy with the character you made (or the one you already have)? Coming to everyone at the same time as the release of Side Effects Guaranteed is a new update that will allow players to respec their character at any time. And for those who want more skills to play around with, a new addition to the custom game options allows you to adjust how many skill points you get per level. Find the balance that is right for you. Or become an Earth Director demi-god. Your worlds, your way. But remember, however you decide to deal with Sub Rosa or the subjects of Elysium Valley will have consequences. Side effects, some might say, that will lead directly into the next installment of The Outer Worlds 2 two-part story expansion when it releases in the spring of 2027. Until then, may skill catch you where fortune fails. Side Effects Guaranteed releases on December 2nd or is available in the Premium Edition or Premium Edition Upgrade for The Outer Worlds 2 .

sources.name: Xbox Wire BR
sources.title: Efeitos colaterais estão garantidos no primeiro DLC de The Outer Worlds 2, que chega em 2 de dezembro
sources.text: Um sinal de socorro leva você e sua tripulação da Incognito até uma nave abandonada, onde vocês encontram os tripulantes em animação suspensa. Tudo indica que há algo de errado, especialmente a poça do que muito provavelmente já foi uma pessoa. Você recupera uma mensagem em vídeo deixada pela capitã da nave, que explica que a tripulação foi contaminada por algo durante um roubo e que, se não encontrarem uma cura, isso causará uma morte celular explosiva. E, por morte celular explosiva, ela quer dizer algo mais parecido com uma… “liquefação”. Pelo jeito da poça no chão: é liquefação mesmo. Esse é o cenário para o lançamento da primeira parte de uma expansão narrativa em DLC de The Outer Worlds 2 , dividida em duas partes, em 2 de dezembro. Em Side Effects Guaranteed, a mensagem em vídeo que você encontrou leva até Gordon Hazen, um dos principais agentes da Sub Rosa, uma organização criminosa formada por pessoas que compartilham dos mesmos ideais e escolheram viver roubando das diversas facções em vez de trabalhar para elas. Gordon, por sua vez, envia você para Elysium Valley, uma nova região de Eden que abriga um assentamento de antigos súditos do Protetorado, esquecidos por seus líderes. Ele acredita que eles podem ter as respostas para salvar sua tripulação. Embora prefira a diplomacia à violência, ele precisa que você faça o que for necessário para conseguir as informações de que precisa. Mas Gordon não é o único interessado em Elysium Valley. Outro agente da Sub Rosa, Algernon Lankester, quer recrutar você para ajudá-lo a explorar os súditos em benefício próprio. O destino dos súditos, dos agentes congelados da Sub Rosa e o futuro da própria organização estão nas suas mãos, nosso intrépido Comandante. No entanto, uma nova história não será a única novidade de Side Effects Guaranteed quando o DLC for lançado daqui a algumas semanas. Além de explorar a nova região de Elysium Valley, os jogadores vão encontrar novas ameaças, como canídeos ferozes e sprats primitivos. O que é um sprat primitivo? É só um sprat normal, mas cerca de 100 vezes maior. Com certeza, eles são tão amigáveis quanto seus primos bem menores e vão perdoar todas as vezes em que você atirou neles “sem querer” enquanto explorava Arcadia. Com essas novas ameaças, vem a possibilidade de deixar seu Comandante ainda mais forte e, é claro, com mais defeitos (mas no bom sentido). O limite de nível aumentará de 30 para 36, trazendo mais pontos de habilidade para diversificar sua configuração de personagem. Poder chegar ao nível 36 também significa que você poderá adquirir mais três vantagens, com 15 vantagens inéditas adicionadas às opções disponíveis. Também serão introduzidos quatro novos defeitos que podem mudar a forma de jogar com seu Comandante, como “Lethally Tolerant”, que reconhece sua resistência acumulada a substâncias químicas e aumenta sua toxicidade máxima. Isso é ótimo na hora, mas, se você sofrer um colapso de toxicidade, morrerá instantaneamente. Outro exemplo é “Must Have Been the Wind”, que marca um “alvo de assassinato” em um grupo de combate. Eliminar o alvo concede um bônus de 20% no dano e na velocidade até o fim do combate, mas não conseguir eliminá-lo ou atacar alguém que não seja o alvo aplica ao jogador uma penalidade de 10% no dano e na velocidade por 30 segundos. São recompensas que realmente vêm acompanhadas de grandes riscos. Side Effects Guaranteed também trará novas armas, novas armaduras e novos trajes para cada um dos companheiros, além de uma estação de rádio inédita comandada pela Sub Rosa, com 20 novas músicas para o jogo. Para quem quiser ir direto à ação no DLC, será adicionado um novo ponto de partida alternativo ao menu principal ao selecionar um novo jogo, permitindo começar com um arquivo de jogo salvo personalizado que coloca você no início do DLC. Inicie o jogo, distribua seus pontos de habilidade e de vantagem e aproveite Side Effects Guaranteed sem demora! Essa aventura repleta de conteúdo, com uma história profunda e sistemas para criar seu Comandante ideal, preparará o terreno para o próximo DLC de The Outer Worlds 2 , que chegará no segundo trimestre de 2027. As escolhas que você fizer terão impacto direto no próximo DLC. A primeira parte dessa história que se desenrola ao longo da expansão, Side Effects Guaranteed, será lançada em 2 de dezembro e também está incluída na Edição Premium ou no Upgrade para a Edição Premium de The Outer Worlds 2 .

sources.title: XBOX Playback chegou: reviva sua história com XBOX
sources.text: A partir de hoje, o XBOX Playback reúne os destaques do seu histórico disponível em XBOX, de todas as gerações, em uma experiência personalizada. Pela primeira vez, você pode relembrar e reviver o papel que teve na história de XBOX. Veja quando sua jornada começou, revisite os jogos aos quais você mais dedicou tempo e redescubra conquistas e momentos ao longo do caminho. Seu Playback inclui seu primeiro jogo de XBOX, o tempo total de jogo, o game que você mais jogou, seus anos de maior atividade, sua maior sequência de dias jogando e muito mais. Como não há dois jogadores iguais, cada pessoa terá um Playback diferente. Seja você um veterano que começou a jogar com um controle Duke ou alguém que ligou seu primeiro console neste ano, uma história personalizada estará esperando por você. A partir de hoje, você pode assistir ao seu Playback diretamente no console (procure a opção no painel) ou assistir ao seu vídeo personalizado na web, entrando com sua conta XBOX aqui . Quer se aprofundar um pouco mais? Acesse seu Arquivo do Playback na web para explorar mais do seu histórico disponível. Relembre alguns dos seus primeiros marcos, suas maiores conquistas e muito mais. O XBOX Playback será disponibilizado gradualmente ao longo do dia, então não se preocupe se ele não aparecer de imediato. Depois de assistir ao seu Playback, escaneie o QR code no final do vídeo no console ou selecione “compartilhar” na web para receber seu cartão personalizado do Playback. Compartilhe com amigos ou publique nas redes sociais com a hashtag #XBOXPlayback. O XBOX Playback reúne anos de história de XBOX de uma maneira totalmente nova. Esperamos que o Playback desperte algumas lembranças, surpreenda você ou traga à memória um jogo em que você não pensava há algum tempo. O Playback se baseia nos dados disponíveis da sua conta, por isso algumas partes do seu histórico podem estar incompletas ou demorar para aparecer. O Playback está disponível em 15 países* ( incluindo o Brasil ) a partir de hoje até 31 de dezembro de 2026. Seja você alguém que joga com a gente desde o início ou que está apenas começando, obrigado por fazer parte de XBOX. *Disponível até 31 de dezembro de 2026 na Argentina, Austrália, Brasil, Canadá, Colômbia, França, Alemanha, Hungria, Itália, México, Polônia, África do Sul, Espanha, Reino Unido e Estados Unidos. Requer pelo menos 1 ponto de Gamerscore (pontuação do jogador) em XBOX, 1 Conquista e 1 minuto de jogo válido vinculados ao seu perfil XBOX; o acesso pelo console requer pelo menos 1 minuto de jogo válido no console. Baseado nos dados disponíveis; alguns dados podem estar incompletos ou apresentar atrasos.

sources.title: Modo Matança chega a DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelações em 16 de novembro
sources.text: Leve suas habilidades de matança ao limite com o Modo Matança, um novo desafio de combate infinito disponível em 16 de novembro como uma atualização gratuita para quem possui DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelações. Vença ondas implacáveis e imprevisíveis cada vez maiores de hordas demoníacas, conquistando seu recorde pessoal e desbloqueando recompensas usando os Crânios coletados da carnificina. Com cada ponto de controle alcançado, os jogadores devem se perguntar se querem resgatar seus lucros ou arriscar tudo para possivelmente aumentar as recompensas. Não existem duas partidas idênticas do MODO MATANÇA enquanto você enfrenta rodadas cada vez mais difíceis deconfrontos, chefes e arenas aleatórios, aumentando o ritmo conforme você avança. Conclua rodadas para ganhar Crânios, que desbloqueiam recompensas como visuais do Slayer exclusivos do Modo Matança, visuais de armas para todos os modos e ícones de perfil. Você também pode desbloquear faixas da Trilha Sonora de IDKFA de Andrew Hulshult para reproduzir no Modo Matança e no Estripatório! Enfrente desafios semanais para ter mais oportunidades de ganhar recompensas e exibir sua proeza de matança. Sobreviva o bastante para alcançar um Ponto de Controle da Rodada e terá a chance de Garantir seus Crânios atuais contra a morte. Ou escolha Arriscar para aumentar seu Multiplicador de Crânios, aumentando os Crânios que receberá durante a partida. Mas tem um porém: se você morrer enquanto Arriscar estiver ativa, todos os seus Crânios não garantidos serão perdidos! Mas a morte não é o fim: cada Ponto de Controle da Rodada que você conclui também desbloqueia outro ponto de início para partidas futuras, permitindo que você continue a carnificina nos confrontos posteriores mais cedo. O Modo Matança estará disponível em 16 de novembro para DOOM: The Dark Ages | Revelações. Este novo modo de jogo está incluso sem custo adicional para jogadores que já tem a DLC Revelações, a Edição Premium de DOOM: The Dark Ages ou a Atualização Premium de DOOM: The Dark Ages.
